data.name: Serotonin
data.subtitle: Semi-jailbreak for iOS 16.5.1 – 17.0
data.localizedDescription: Serotonin is a semi-untethered 'semi-jailbreak' for iOS 16.5.1 through 16.7 RC and iOS 17.0 on arm64e devices. Built on the Fugu15 code base, it gives you tweak injection and a Procursus bootstrap without a full jailbreak: tweaks load into the apps you patch, and the device keeps working normally everywhere else.

compatibility.notes: Official .tipa from mineek/Serotonin. Supported firmware is iOS 16.5.1 – 16.7 RC and 17.0; the upstream release line stopped in January 2024 and later Dopamine versions cover much of the same range, so treat this as a legacy option for devices that cannot run Dopamine. Upstream ships the TrollStore-named .tipa (identical container to an .ipa); rename it to .ipa if your client rejects the extension.
